subject.title: fix(media): support configurable containerWorkdir in sandbox media path normalization (#98446)

question: Should maintainers keep this conflicting branch as the candidate after cleanup, or consolidate the OpenShell media fix on the sibling branch at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100837?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same canonical bug, this branch has a useful implementation but is dirty and contains unrelated docs, and automation should not choose the final landing branch for maintainers.

options.title: Require this branch to be cleaned
options.body: Ask the author to rebase, drop the unrelated doctor docs change, and add focused regression coverage before this PR remains the candidate.

options.title: Consolidate on the sibling branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100837 as the candidate if its proof gap is resolved, then close this PR as superseded after that branch becomes safe.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and wait for maintainer-owned proof or a fresh branch if neither current PR becomes clean enough to land.

recommendation.title: Require this branch to be cleaned
recommendation.body: Ask the author to rebase, drop the unrelated doctor docs change, and add focused regression coverage before this PR remains the candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history covers both the OpenShell workdir contract and sandbox media helpers, making them the best available routing owner for candidate selection.
